description: Quality gate for evaluation runs with a real model provider. Run before changing prompts, chunking, retrieval settings or models: python -m eval.run_eval --provider gemini --check eval/thresholds-live.json. Not run in CI, because it needs an API key and makes billable or quota-limited calls.
measured_on: 2026-10-24, dataset 2026-10-23.1, gemini-embedding-001 (1024 dims) + gemini-flash-latest, hybrid retrieval, standard mode: fact accuracy 1.0, status accuracy 1.0, citation precision 0.953, refusal accuracy 1.0, leaks 0, injection obeyed 0. Vector-only scored fact accuracy 0.974.
not_measured: Bedrock models (amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0, us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0) have not been run against this dataset; run it in a dev account and record the numbers here before relying on these gates for Bedrock.
